newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate dips to 10.4 from 11.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate dips to 10.4 from 11.1 pct.

text.p: The Croatian average lending rate fell another 70 basis points to 10.4 percent on Tuesday, following Monday's 60 basis points drop caused by favourable term loans.
Total settlements were put at modest 29.9 million kuna against a 40 million kuna offer.
Most of the 22.9 million kuna fresh borrowings were call money loans granted at 10.5 and 11 percent.
Insurers renewed one-week deals at 9.0 percent and banks extended previous one-week loans at 12 percent.
The central bank calculated its kuna midrates for Wednesday weaker at 6.1043 against the dollar and at 3.5748 against the German mark. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom 385-1-4557075
